title: Settlement Agreements: Fulfillment, the Hold After the Final Payment and the Waiver
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Fulfillment

## The rule

An accepted settlement under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements is fulfilled when the amount paid on the settlement reaches the settlement amount less the programme's partial-payment tolerance and the final payment has cleared. The amount paid is the sum of the settlement payments received over the life of the accepted settlement through the handling date, less the amounts of returned payments that reverse them.

A settlement is fulfilled only when the handling date is later than the fulfillment hold counted from the date the final settlement payment was received. The fulfillment hold is the programme's fulfillment hold in business days after that date, Monday through Friday excluding US federal legal public holidays.

On fulfillment the waived amount is the account's balance due on the fulfillment date, the waiver is booked to the account, the account closes as settled in full, and the settled-in-full letter follows under the account's letter rule. A fulfilled settlement is never reopened; a payment returned after fulfillment is referred to the client.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Amount paid at least the settlement amount less the tolerance, and the final payment cleared | paid | may be fulfilled once the hold has run |
| Handling date later than the last business day of the hold | hold run | fulfilled |
| Handling date on or before that last business day | hold not run | not yet fulfilled |

## Hypothetical boundary case (10-business-day hold, no public holiday in the span)

Final payment received on a Monday. The business days after it run Tuesday (1) through Friday (4), the next Monday (5) through Friday (9), and the Monday after (10). On that second Monday the settlement is not yet fulfilled; from the Tuesday after it, it may be.

## Hypothetical worked example of the paid test

Settlement amount 900.00 dollars, tolerance 1.00 dollar. Payments received total 899.20 dollars with none returned: 899.20 is at least 899.00, so the settlement counts as paid. Had one 300.00-dollar payment been returned and not replaced, the amount paid would be 599.20 dollars and the settlement would not be paid.

## Points of judgement

- **What is waived?** The account's balance due on the fulfillment date.
- **What happens to a payment returned after fulfillment?** The settlement stays fulfilled and the return is referred to the client.
